newsitem.title: PERU: Peru net reserves rise to $9.996 bln on July 24.
newsitem.headline: Peru net reserves rise to $9.996 bln on July 24.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank said Friday its net international reserves stood at $9.996 billion on July 24, up from $9.902 billion the week before.
Peru's reserves, which have been recovering steadily since President Alberto Fujimori's government took power in 1990, stood at $8.540 billion at the end of 1996.
Fujimori has forecast that this quarter the reserves will break the $10 billion barrier for the first time ever.
